task.name: look for bugs or optimizations
task.prompt: go through the entire code base and look for any optimizations (bother for engine and game performance) speed up where possible, fix any potential bugs you see, and in general improve the code base
task.notes: Targeted optimization pass over the per-frame hot path. Main win: ObjectStore::Find was a linear O(n) scan and is called many times per frame from PhysicsWorld::Step (per body, plus recursive GlobalPose parent walks), ScriptHost transform synchronization (per proxy, per script), BuildSceneFrame/ParentMatrix, and scene lookups - giving O(n^2) behaviour as scenes grow. Added an ID->GameObject* hash index (std::unordered_map) maintained by Restore/Remove/move-assignment; pointers are stable because GameObjects are heap-owned by unique_ptr, so the index survives vector growth and store moves. Find is now O(1). Deeper items were assessed and deliberately deferred as high risk relative to reward: script VM is a string-keyed tree-walker (bytecode/interned-locals rewrite), GameObject::GetBehavior uses dynamic_cast in a loop (needs a type-tag system), BehaviorLifecycle::Ordered shuffles+sorts 3x/frame (the shuffle is intentional anti-order-dependence). Verified: rebuilt and ran CoreTests, SceneTests, ScriptHostTests, PhysicsTests, LifecycleTests, ScriptEditorTests, and every zEngineAssetTests suite (objects, scenes, hierarchy, prefabs, editor, text, folders) - all pass.
